np-0YtE.title: Bollard: black-white striped concrete, red top
np-0YtE.summary: Black-and-white striped concrete bollards, often with a red mark on top. They have 3 to 5 stripes.

np-13Id.title: Coverage: overcast but brighter forest valley
np-13Id.summary: North of Phakding, more overcast coverage in the same forest valley, but much brighter.

np-15gH.title: Coverage: dark overcast forested valley
np-15gH.summary: Around the southern tip of the trekker coverage, dark, overcast coverage inside a forested valley.

np-3OLY.title: Roofs: sheet metal
np-3OLY.summary: In the far east: sheet metal roofs with a triangular window just below the ridge and an outward-sloping section underneath.

np-3thG.title: Plants: tea plantations, far east only
np-3thG.summary: Tea plantations are found only in the far east, both in the mountains and on the flat land.

np-4SYu.title: Google car: blocky grey truck
np-4SYu.summary: A blocky grey truck east of Birgunj and just south of the capital.

np-4cJ4.title: Landscape: dry western hills, bare slopes
np-4cJ4.summary: The western hills look dry, with many bare hillsides lacking vegetation.

np-5sld.title: Landscape: barren mountain trails in the north
np-5sld.summary: Barren mountain trails appear in the northern parts of the trekker coverage.

np-6zi1.title: Sky: small spotty clouds like chimney smoke
np-6zi1.summary: Further north the cloud blanket gives way to small, spotty clouds that look a bit like smoke from chimneys.

np-7qax.title: Landmark: white stupa, painted eyes
np-7qax.summary: A white-painted Buddhist stupa, sometimes with painted eyes on the sides, found only here.

np-8fCe.title: Road: yellow-orange dirt, high-altitude oaks
np-8fCe.summary: A rough yellow-orange dirt road in high-altitude land with mountain oaks, northeast of Phungling in the far northeast.

np-8n9O.title: Sign: black-and-white striped posts
np-8n9O.summary: Black-and-white striped signposts. India, Bhutan, Bangladesh, Sri Lanka and Malaysia use them too.

np-8v2z.title: Sky: many irregular clouds over peaks
np-8v2z.summary: East of the glacier, many irregular clouds spread across the sky and cover various peaks.

np-Awwe.title: Ground: neat grey square stone tiles
np-Awwe.summary: Flat, square, grey stone tiles are common south of the capital, around Birgunj and Janakpur. Parts of India that look similar to Nepal do not have such neat square tiles.

differs.how: Neat square stone tiles are not found in similar-looking parts

np-Cs2W.title: Google car: blue car with antenna
np-Cs2W.summary: If the blue car has an antenna, you are around Pokhara.

np-Dg6E.title: Landscape: cloud-blanketed peak
np-Dg6E.summary: On a section north of Phorste you see Tobuche mountain covered in a blanket of clouds.

np-E2q2.title: Landscape: crossing a glacier
np-E2q2.summary: After losing sight of the spiky mountains you cross a glacier, the largest snow-covered patch with coverage in the country.

np-Eg1M.title: Houses: gable ends with gold carved gods
np-Eg1M.summary: Gable ends decorated with carved gods, goddesses and religious symbols, usually painted gold, mostly around Kawasoti, west of Bharatpur.

np-FSi3.title: Village: sparse, huge mountain close
np-FSi3.summary: Phorste is sparsely built with a massive, recognisable mountain nearby and many dead-looking trees around.

np-GK0F.title: Roofs: big metal hip roofs, small ridge bump
np-GK0F.summary: Large hip roofs of sheet metal with a small protrusion just below the ridge, around Biratnagar in the east.

np-Ipk5.title: Landscape: snowy, shining mountain range
np-Ipk5.summary: Next to the village of Thame you see a snowy mountain range shining brightly.

np-JXKf.title: Plants: areca palms, thin trunk, small crown
np-JXKf.summary: Areca palms have a very thin trunk and a small crown. Mainly in the southeast.

np-K8df.title: Valley: wide high-altitude river valley
np-K8df.summary: Near the final stretch toward Everest, a wide, high-altitude river valley.

np-KIyv.title: Coverage: largest, densest trekker village
np-KIyv.summary: Namche Bazar is by far the largest and most densely populated settlement with trekker coverage, with some coverage looking down on the town.

np-L6Cc.title: Google car: regular grey car
np-L6Cc.summary: A regular grey car around the capital and to the southeast around Lahan.

np-L7uv.title: Trail: overcast mountainside, trees
np-L7uv.summary: Slightly east of Namche Bazar, a very overcast trail along the mountainside with some trees, noticeably higher above the valley than other overcast tree sections.

np-LKPy.title: Coverage: sunny, bright forest valley
np-LKPy.summary: From Monjo up to Namche Bazar, in the same valley, mostly sunny and bright coverage.

np-OjoN.title: Plants: grass with white fluffy tips
np-OjoN.summary: Grass with white, fluffy tips is most common just southeast of the capital. It is found in much of the country but looks less white outside the marked dark-red area.

np-Px6r.title: Google car: car with black spoiler
np-Px6r.summary: A car with a black spoiler, just around Janakpur, southeast of the capital.

np-QPNM.title: Landscape: semi-green valley
np-QPNM.summary: Northeast of Namche Bazar, a semi-green river valley with clouds covering all the surrounding mountains.

np-TvYi.title: Coverage: end of trail
np-TvYi.summary: At the end of the coverage you finally get a clear view of Mount Everest, the world's tallest mountain.

np-Tzjk.title: Mosques: only a few southern Muslim areas
np-Tzjk.summary: Mosques cluster in a few Muslim-majority spots in the south: around Janakpur, around Birgunj, around Nepalgunj in the west, and around Biratnagar west of the Koshi river.

np-UiDS.title: Trail: massive mountains, hazy sun
np-UiDS.summary: The trail between Pangboche and Dingboche has massive mountains and a somewhat hazy sun.

np-VYWX.title: Landscape: red rugged mountainside next to
np-VYWX.summary: East of the glacial valley, a somewhat red, rugged mountainside right beside the trail.

np-WzwA.title: Roofs: corrugated metal sheets
np-WzwA.summary: Corrugated metal sheet roofs are most common between Birgunj and Janakpur.

np-Y0PQ.title: Google car: red car, usually long antenna
np-Y0PQ.summary: A red car, usually with a long antenna, in the capital and north of Janakpur, southeast of the capital.

np-Y1VK.title: Houses: colourful blocks
np-Y1VK.summary: Colourful blocky multi-storey buildings or small houses with painted concrete, red brick or thatch-like walls and tile or tin roofs. Triangle-shaped decorations are often on the facade.

np-Zjaj.title: Valley: high-altitude, very low clouds
np-Zjaj.summary: North of Dingboche, a high-altitude valley with very low clouds over the sky and most surrounding mountains.

np-aJ2N.title: Pole: cross attached near the top
np-aJ2N.summary: Poles with a cross attached near the top are common in the east.

np-ansC.title: Village: jagged mountain above, green roofs
np-ansC.summary: Khumjung, just north of Namche Bazar, has a jagged mountain towering over it and almost every house has a green roof. A Khumjung label further north is not near the village.

np-cOqH.title: Google car: orange car with blue ribbon on
np-cOqH.summary: An orange car with a blue ribbon on the front, around Biratnagar.

np-cqVV.title: Coverage: trekker only in the northeast
np-cqVV.summary: Trekker coverage is limited to the northeast, southwest of Mount Everest.

np-cvRP.title: Road: dirt track in a valley
np-cvRP.summary: A dirt track in a valley heading northwest with snowcapped mountains ahead. North of a national park in the west.

np-cwQB.title: Landscape: small icy lake
np-cwQB.summary: Past Tobuche, a small ice-covered lake right by Gokyo with jagged mountains behind.

np-dAPp.title: Roofs: metal hip roofs, tiny ridge protrusion
np-dAPp.summary: Like the previous one, but with an even smaller metal piece at the ridge, mainly west of and around Biratnagar.

np-djZd.title: Camera: low-quality, brownish, big blur on car
np-djZd.summary: All road coverage uses a low-quality camera: brownish colours and often, not always, a large round blur over the car. Very common in India, rare in Bangladesh and Sri Lanka.

np-eQQW.title: Plants: tall Japanese cedar
np-eQQW.summary: Japanese cedars grow only in the far east. They are very tall with narrow, fluffy-looking crowns.

np-evPB.title: Landscape: high hills with dark green
np-evPB.summary: Some roads north of Siddhicharan in the east have high hills with plenty of dark green rhododendron bushes. Their red flowers can be hard to see.

np-fB1L.title: Landscape: spiky mountain range
np-fB1L.summary: Above the U-shaped valley, a spiky mountain range, mostly clearly visible with some clouds around the peaks.

np-fClz.title: Landscape: completely barren
np-fClz.summary: Closing in on Everest the landscape is completely barren, with the trail heading north-northeast.

np-fLll.title: Pole: square concrete, trident top
np-fLll.summary: Square concrete poles on flat land and thin metal poles in the mountains, often with a trident top. Concrete with trident top and triangle supports is unique here, and a square concrete pole with two vertical insulators far apart is almost unique. Others can look like Indian poles.

differs.how: Other pole types look very similar to Indian ones

np-gXQt.title: Google car: white car
np-gXQt.summary: A white car around Butwal, the H10 to Pokhara, the H04 east to the capital, some roads near the capital, northeast of Birgunj, from Janakpur to Lahan, and around Itahari in the east.

np-h60b.title: Village: fairly large, bright
np-h60b.summary: Pangboche is a fairly large settlement with fairly bright coverage, forested mountains nearby and taller mountains in the distance.

np-hHGC.title: Valley: U-shaped, climbing steeply
np-hHGC.summary: After the red mountainside, a somewhat U-shaped valley going steadily upward.

np-hSPg.title: Plants: bright yellow canola fields
np-hSPg.summary: Canola, a crop with bright yellow flowers, is mostly in a few southern pockets in the western half.

np-hURU.title: Roofs: organised tiles with small diamond bumps
np-hURU.summary: More orderly tiles with small diamond-shaped bumps, most common in the far western flat region. Also works for half-rounded tiles.

np-ikN4.title: Google car: orange car
np-ikN4.summary: An orange Google car appears around Nepalgunj in the west, Madi south of Bharatpur, Biratnagar in the east, and Birtamod in the far east.

np-j2HS.title: Landscape: clear view of the peak
np-j2HS.summary: Even further north the clouds disappear and the Tobuche peak is clearly visible.

np-jtSd.title: Landscape: barren land
np-jtSd.summary: North of the icy lake the land is barren, with a trail heading north-northwest.

np-l5Hu.title: Pole: asymmetric crossbar with triangle on top
np-l5Hu.summary: In the capital, poles have an asymmetrical crossbar with a triangular attachment on top and a support bar below.

np-lNEk.title: Valley: forested slopes
np-lNEk.summary: The valley by Thamu has generally forested mountainsides and runs northwest to southeast.

np-m56H.title: Coverage: narrow street, big buildings
np-m56H.summary: The southernmost trekker coverage is in Lukla: a narrow street with relatively large buildings and extremely dark coverage.

np-mLJ5.title: Google car: grey car with visible rear window
np-mLJ5.summary: A grey car with a visible backlight around Pokhara, around the capital, north of Malangawa near the Indian border, and east of Itahari in the east.

np-oEN0.title: Coverage: sunny trails at treeline
np-oEN0.summary: Around Namche Bazar the coverage is sunny, with trails near the treeline, so you are at the top of or just above a forest, with barren or snowy mountains somewhere in view.

np-oMsb.title: Landscape: view of the peak from the east
np-oMsb.summary: Further along, a view over Tobuche from the east. Mountains get more cloud-covered to the west.

np-oWV4.title: Landscape: flat farmland south
np-oWV4.summary: Flat agricultural land in the south and high-altitude mountain roads in the north half.

np-oxoV.title: Road lines: yellow dashed or solid edges
np-oxoV.summary: Yellow edge lines, dashed or solid, with dashed white centre lines on bigger roads. Solid yellow edges are very common in the east of the central province.

np-p8KJ.title: Roofs: railing along the sides, dark concrete
np-p8KJ.summary: Roofs with a railing along the sides, usually dark concrete, in parts of the west, most commonly in the Tulsipur valley where it is sometimes stair-shaped. The eastern limit is the plains near Kawasoti, and the far west has poorer rails, sometimes just sticks.

np-p93Y.title: Valley: dried glacial valley, bright grey rocks
np-p93Y.summary: East of Gokyo, a dried-out glacial valley with bright grey rocks as far as you can see. It is less commonly seen from the trail north of Gokyo.

np-sqGf.title: Landscape: flat far south
np-sqGf.summary: The far south near the Indian border is almost totally flat. The centre and north are very high and mountainous.

np-tKtn.title: Plate: long, white; red private, black public
np-tKtn.summary: Fairly long plates, most often white. Private vehicles use red plates and public vehicles black ones.

np-tzvh.title: Vegetation: green forest in the south of the
np-tzvh.summary: Green forests and trees appear in the southern parts of the trekker coverage.

np-uRkU.title: Water tanks: green and black
np-uRkU.summary: Green and black water tanks are common everywhere. Yellow ones are mainly in the east.

np-uTPc.title: Plants: chir pines, smooth crown, long needles
np-uTPc.summary: Chir pines have smooth cone or ball shaped crowns with very long needles. Found throughout the mountains but far more in the west and near the capital. The east is generally greener than the west.

np-uYxZ.title: Roofs: untidy rectangular tiles
np-uYxZ.summary: Rectangular tiles with messier shapes and placement are common in western mountain towns, and also towards the centre.

np-vYvI.title: Vegetation: foggy road, tall dark fir forest
np-vYvI.summary: A foggy, gloomy road with the only natural forest dominated by east Himalayan fir: tall dark trees all around. It is northwest of Bhimeshwor, east of the capital.

np-xEXu.title: Roofs: rounded tiles, flat south and west
np-xEXu.summary: Rounded roof tiles are most common on the flat land south of the capital and also widespread further west. Don't confuse them with the half-rounded tiles in the next tip.

np-xHyX.title: Houses: small round clay huts, thatched roofs
np-xHyX.summary: Small round clay huts with thatched roofs are mainly around Birgunj. They are also common just across the border in India.

np-yXhS.title: Addresses: district shown, often in English
np-yXhS.summary: Districts can appear in addresses, often in English too.

np-zQR5.title: Google car: blue car
np-zQR5.summary: A blue car around Pokhara, Birgunj (southwest of the capital) and Malangawa (near the Indian border southeast of the capital).

np-zYdm.title: Fences: stick fences of varying quality
np-zYdm.summary: Fences made mostly of sticks, of varying quality, are most common in the eastern plains.

np-zeXz.title: Language: Devanagari
np-zeXz.summary: Devanagari script: a line runs along the top of each word and most letters have straight vertical strokes. The letters ङ and ङ्ग are much more common than in Hindi or Marathi, and local-script numbers on signs are common, but very rare in India.

differs.how: Same script, but fewer ङ letters and few Devanagari numbers on signs

np-zxhL.title: Trail: overcast forest, bright sandy dirt
np-zxhL.summary: East of the place called Deboche, very overcast forest coverage. The dirt is very bright and sandy, unlike the southern trail.
